execution_jobs.assessment_policy: all groups for one task in a durable job; resume exact complete groups

geometry.utility_execution_duplicate: clean only, excluded from scientific rows

operation_accounting: explicit complete cohort updates and rows, including both D passes/I backward/Adam, every native validation/parity/publication and all crossed/utility/control cells

primitive_recipes.H_bank: one native forward per source stream, original unpadded token pooling, full numeric/base proof and immutable publication
primitive_recipes.assessment: each supported cell: intact+donor+patched for interchange/replay/empty, intact+patched for zero/H-mean; one three-forward all-sender positive per row
primitive_recipes.binary_parity: native dual eval versus donor+patched single-stream exported hooks
primitive_recipes.checkpoint: hash intact base and complete safe gate/Adam/RNG boundary; largest10-record immutable validation-reference history
primitive_recipes.targets: two dual native forwards per D/I/H chunk; detached readouts
primitive_recipes.update: D no-grad then identical D graph/backward plus I graph/backward; candidate regularizer and one Adam step
primitive_recipes.validation: primary score and self replay each use intact+donor+patched; positive uses intact+donor+patched all-sender readout; IOI duplicates clean only in physical execution

storage_requirements.policy: full source/row/inventory retention, all1200 boundaries, immutable validation artifacts and largest atomic publication; measured host peak added separately
